verdict.rationale: LangSmith docs show custom metadata/tags can be attached to traces and used to group dashboard metrics (including token usage) by attribute, and alerts can be set on cost, enabling attribution of cost/usage to arbitrary dimensions like user, session, or feature via metadata. Missing for 10: a concrete worked example of per-user/session/feature cost breakdown and independent/hands-on corroboration that metadata-based cost attribution works well in practice.
